response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) AS fraction FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), r AS (SELECT telescref, signal_count, fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fraction DESC) AS rnk FROM t) SELECT telescref, signal_count, fraction FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC, telescref

assumptions.assumption: All rows in signals form the denominator (total signal count); telescref is NOT NULL so no null group exists.
Ties with the 10th place are included using RANK on the fraction (equivalent to ranking by count).
